name: Murim Cultivation
desc:
🔥 MURIM – Martial Arts Cultivation 🔥

Become a true Murim master.
Meditate, cultivate your Qi, and break through increasingly powerful realms.

📜 Credits
Programming: IcedOutRaccoon, LuaCold, CryptedChloes  
Map Design: Cyze1, V0unds, Salé

❗Important Notice
Murim Cultivation will no longer be closed for any reason. Murim Cultivation will no longer receive any revamps but will still receive updates as needed which may include content and bug fixes. This does not mean Murim Cultivation's vision is being left to die we are starting a new project which will be named Murim Cultivation 2 which will recieve further information as it progresses. To stay up to date please join the socials under the game. MURIM CULTIVATION 2 WILL NOT ERASE YOUR DATA OR OVERWRITE THIS GAME.

Keywords: Murim, Manhwa, Martial Arts, Cultivation, Qi, Action RPG, Solo Progression, Exploration, Combat
